name: Willys MB jeep
identity: Supplied jeep_willys_mb__free_download_daz3d_poser.glb (uchronia, Sketchfab, CC-BY-NC-ND-4.0): one Willys MB with windshield, folded top bows, stowage (bags, jerrycans, axe, shovel, rope) and a spare wheel. The baked model is local-only (git-ignored, licence not redistributable); without it the committed part-built fallback (models/jeep_fallback) is drawn.

model.note: converted by tools/vehicles/convert_vehicles.py willys into assets_src/vehicles/jeep_willys.glb first

fallbackModel.note: part-built stand-in made of boxes and cylinders by tools/vehicles/make_jeep_fallback.py (committed)

rig.note: driver's eye = steering wheel centre + driverEyeFromSteer (left-hand drive); exits beside the doors, beside the body, behind, ahead

colliders.note: one body box in hull space from the baked hull bounds

carDrive.note: steerRate: lock fractions per second (the input is smoothed); steerTurns: steering-wheel turns lock to lock; runOverDamage: soldier damage per m/s of impact speed

mobility.note: gameplay profile: 65 km/h on worn routes (roads), 39 km/h off-road

ramming.note: Willys MB ~1,040 kg empty, 60 hp Go Devil engine

dash.note: VH6b src/vehicle_dash.cpp: the interior content/vehicles/dash/jeep_willys.json, anchored at the driver's eye + offset
